difficulty.reason: Registering a GitHub OAuth App or GitHub App requires no upfront manual approval or app store review, allowing immediate testing and deployment.

timeEstimate.notes: GitHub OAuth apps are immediately active upon creation. GitHub Apps also require no waiting period unless submitted to the GitHub Marketplace.

requirements.text: A verified GitHub account with Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) enabled
Basic application details (Application name, Homepage URL, Authorization callback URL)

steps.title: Navigate to Developer Settings
steps.description: Log into GitHub, go to your profile Settings, scroll down to 'Developer settings', and select either 'OAuth Apps' or 'GitHub Apps'.

steps.title: Register a New Application
steps.description: Click 'New OAuth App' (or 'New GitHub App' if fine-grained permissions/webhooks are needed). Fill out the Application name, Homepage URL, and Authorization callback URL.

steps.title: Generate Client Secrets
steps.description: After registering, generate a Client Secret. Store the Client ID and Client Secret securely in your environment variables.

blockers.problem: Incorrect Callback URL configuration causing authorization failures.
blockers.solution: Ensure the callback URL matches the exact protocol, domain, port, and path configured in your application routing.

blockers.problem: GitHub's strict rate limiting on unauthenticated or standard OAuth requests.
blockers.solution: Ensure your AI agent properly handles HTTP 403 rate limit headers and uses authenticated requests tied to user tokens.

agentCanDo: Handle the OAuth authorization code exchange (code for access token)
Refresh tokens or manage token storage securely
Programmatically execute GitHub API calls once authenticated
developerMustDo: Log in to the GitHub developer portal using personal 2FA
Create and register the OAuth App or GitHub App credentials
Configure redirect URIs and scopes in the developer console

managedOption.managedSufficientWhen: Building standard multi-tenant AI agents where users connect their personal or organization GitHub accounts via a managed auth provider like Composio. Note: This tool was built for a Composio assignment, and Composio sells managed OAuth.
managedOption.customRequiredWhen: Building a custom enterprise-grade branded product where you require direct control over GitHub App ownership, proprietary webhook delivery, or custom GitHub Marketplace distribution.

sources.title: Creating an OAuth App - GitHub Docs

claims.claim: GitHub OAuth apps are created instantly with no app store review or approval wait time required.
Developers can register OAuth apps under either personal settings or organization settings.

openQuestions: Are there specific automated security flags that can temporarily suspend an unverified GitHub OAuth app if it generates sudden high-volume API requests from an AI agent?
